text: The paper reports that contractors' mean accuracy and time to evaluate helpful-prover solutions both improve over checkability-training rounds, and that by the end the helpful prover matches the initialization's legibility with substantially stronger performance, but its performance falls short of the correctness-only prover, which the authors describe as a tension between performance and legibility.
title: Helpful prover grows more legible to humans, with a performance-legibility tension vs correctness-only prover
